Second pre-release of 2.3 — **look up metadata, in the language you want**.

## New

- **Look up metadata** (Metadata area toolbar *Look up …*, *Edit > Look up metadata …*, or right-click in the library): asks Google Books and Open Library and lists the hits with a small cover. For each field you see the book's value next to the hit's value and tick what to take — title, authors, publisher, date, language, ISBN, tags, your subtitle field, blurb and cover. Only fields the book lacks are ticked at first. With several books selected the window goes through them one by one (*Apply and next* / *Skip*).
- **Language for look-ups**: pick a language in the window, or set a preferred one under *Settings > Books > Blurbs* (default: same as the book). Another language than the book's searches without the ISBN and only finds editions in that language — e.g. German blurbs for English books where the title is the same. It also applies to *Look up all missing blurbs* and to Claude's source profiles.
- Fix: the *Publication date* switch from 2.3-beta1 was not saved.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on), or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_2.3-beta2.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
